Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time on the call last week. We’d love to run a 30-minute demo of the Redwood inference platform for your ML and infra teams. Based on availability you shared, does Friday, Feb 18 at 11:00 AM PT work? We’ll cover a short overview, a focused walk-through of embeddings + reranking for search, and a quick Q&A.

Agenda (30m):
- 5m intro & goals
- 15m live demo (embeddings -> retrieval -> rerank)
- 10m product fit & next steps
